Solar Sandbox

Solar Sandbox is a game where you can interact with physics in space.

Get the game on Steam or Google Play :

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4307880/Solar_Sandbox/

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=solar.sandbox

If the Discord link does not work: https://discord.gg/bxKeeGCEwD
